prior_qa_run_disposition.reason: 2026 sparse modern Auction call rows were assigned contract-month values (202609/202610) as Trading Volume because the text parser used a positional fallback with too few numeric columns.

integrity_rules: Modern Auction rows: contract month and last-trading-day prefix can never be interpreted as volume.
Modern Auction rows with insufficient price/trade-field tokens are classified as NO_TRADE and Trading Volume=0.
Only rows with sufficient explicit trade-field tokens may use the modern positional volume field.
Legacy spaced-glyph rows may reconstruct digits only inside the observed volume/value segment; no manual per-row numeric patching.
Every selected leg must retain raw-line evidence and extraction_mode for audit.
Same frozen 9 QA dates must be rerun; no replacement dates.
Legacy Auction no-trade rows with ellipsis-only trade fields must map Trading Volume to zero; option code, last-trading-day date, and open interest are never volume.
Weekly option rows identified by YYYYMMDD MM.DD prefix are excluded before any standard-month or legacy parser fallback.
Transition-layout Auction volume must be captured from the explicit NetChange -> Volume -> TradingValue -> Settlement field sequence; tail-relative numeric indexing is forbidden.
Transition-layout J-NET rows must be segmented per issue before parsing OHLC -> Volume -> TradingValue; a second issue on the same extracted line may not be discarded.
Market state may carry across pages only when the current page has no explicit market heading; whole-page Auction/J-NET headings override prior state.
Nikkei reference-label matching must be whitespace-normalized before anchor comparison; this normalization may not alter numeric OHLC extraction.
